item.title: PZ Cussons: caring products group reports tomorrow and the figures will be good, shares up nearly 30% in six weeks
item.summary: It could well be worth taking another look at the shares of PZ Cussons (LON:PZC) ahead of the group declaring its 2026 results tomorrow morning. On Friday, 12th June, I stated in this column that I had a good feeling that this group’s shares, then trading at around the 87.50p level, were priming themselves for an upward push over the 100p barrier, and then to trade the 110p […] The post PZ Cussons: caring products group reports tomorrow and the figures will be good, shares up nearly 30% in six weeks appeared first on UK Investor Magazine .
